signatures.description: Write a software triangle rasterizer that applies the top-left fill rule at integer subpixel precision, interpolates attributes perspective-correctly using 1/w, and resolves depth with a z-buffer after near-plane clipping in homogeneous space. Guard-band clipping must not introduce cracks between adjacent triangles, and degenerate or back-facing primitives must be culled without leaving depth artifacts. Verify pixel-exact coverage against a reference raster catalog including shared-edge and shared-vertex cases.
